name: Richis
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Richis is an Irish heroine. This satirist rebuked the great hero Cuchulainn after he took the life of her foster son, Crimthann Nia Nair. Her courage did not save her, and she died in the same manner as Crimthann.

okr.objective: Richis is an Irish heroine who challenged Cuchulainn.
key_results: She rebuked Cuchulainn after Crimthann was slain.
She lost her life as Crimthann did.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
